providers.title: A product of two simplices beats the simplex (OpenAI)
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exponential excess (OpenAI)
providers.scope: There are lambda > 1 and N such that for every n >= N some product of simplices K_n in R^n has R_n(K_n) >= lambda^n c_n. Proved in the third lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Support functions determine compact convex sets
providers.scope: For nonempty compact convex C, D: C is contained in D if and only if h_C <= h_D.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Projection of a facet
providers.scope: The (d-1)-volume of the orthogonal projection of a facet onto u-perp is its area times |<a_j, u>|.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cauchy's formula for polytopes
providers.scope: For a polytope P and unit u, vol_(d-1)(projection of P onto u-perp) = (1/2) sum_j s_j |<a_j, u>|; the projection body is the zonotope of the segments [-s_j a_j/2, s_j a_j/2].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Affine covariance (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Pi(LP + x_0) = |det L| L^(-T) Pi P for invertible L, and R_d is invariant under invertible affine maps.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Projection bodies of convex bodies (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every convex body K has a projection body Pi K; circumscribed polytopes P_m have R_d(P_m) tending to R_d(K), and R_d is affine invariant on convex bodies.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Products (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For polytopes A in R^r and B in R^s, r, s >= 2: Pi(A x B) = (|B| Pi A) x (|A| Pi B) and R_(r+s)(A x B) = R_r(A) R_s(B).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Facets of the simplex
providers.scope: The standard simplex T_d has facet vectors -e_i/(d-1)! and (e_1 + ... + e_d)/(d-1)!.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Extrusion
providers.scope: For compact convex C and v != 0, |C + [0, v]| = |C| + |v| vol_(d-1)(projection of C onto v-perp).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The simplex value (OpenAI)
providers.scope: |Pi T_d| = (d+1)/((d-1)!)^d and R_d(S) = c_d = (d+1) d^d/d! for every d-dimensional simplex S.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The product test (OpenAI)
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The first dimension is twenty
providers.scope: No product of simplices of dimensions at least two exceeds the simplex value in dimensions up to nineteen; T_10 x T_10 does in dimension twenty.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
